name: Extra Strategy [Psionic]
body:
You gain extra daily uses of your strategy ability.

Prerequisite: Strategy class feature

Benefit: You gain two additional daily uses of your strategy class feature.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Its effects stack.
